name: [🎃] Candy Kingdom Defense
desc:
Welcome to Candy Kingdom Defense! 🍬🏰

🗡️ Team up with Adventure Boy, Stretchy Dog, the Candy Princess, the Vampire Queen and a whole crew of heroes in this action-packed tower defense game! Candy zombies, snow golems and the Lemon Earl's sour army are marching on the kingdom, and only YOU can stop them!

⚔️ Summon legendary heroes from the Treasure Hoard and wipe out wave after wave of invaders!
⚡️ Level up your squad, reroll for Mythic traits, and EVOLVE your heroes into Cosmic Dog, Adventure Man, Game King and more!
🌌 Battle through 7 worlds and 35 stages, survive endless waves in Infinite Mode, and take on brutal Challenges!
👀 Hunt for secret heroes, climb the weekly tournament and test your squad in PvP Battles!

📱💻 Play on PC, Mobile & Tablet. Squad up with up to 3 friends and save the kingdom together!
🔥 Like, favorite and join the community for new codes, rare rewards and update news! Redeem codes at Stretchy Dog's Code Corner in the Tree Fort.

llm.loop: summon heroes -> place them to defend against waves -> earn gems and drops -> level, reroll traits and evolve heroes -> clear worlds and challenges
llm.objectives: defend the Candy Kingdom across 7 worlds and 35 stages
llm.progression: heroes, traits, evolutions, worlds, battlepass, tournaments
llm.instructions: summon heroes, wipe out waves, evolve squad, infinite mode, challenges, PvP
llm.thumbnails: Finn-like hero with sword and vampire-faced villain in a candy kingdom
llm.complexity_notes: many hero units with evolutions, 35 stages, PvP
